moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and the honest prerequisite list - Python and Jupyter or Colab, H2O for AutoML, and rJava wired against your PDI install for the R-backed steps.

moduleSummaries.title: Machine Learning
